packages.name: Connection lifecycle
packages.note: Native workflow name. Not an installed orchestration package.

packages.name: Approval
packages.note: Native workflow name. Not an installed orchestration package.

packages.name: Cross-host handoff
packages.trigger: The Work owner requests a handoff to an authorized host or participant.

approval.requiredFor: Confirming the recipient and the exact context allowed to travel

packages.output: Scoped handoff and a resume checkpoint for the same Work ID
packages.verification: Open the Work on the destination through Spine Network MCP after sign-in. Confirm the Work ID, current decisions, pending commitments and effective access against Platform.
packages.note: Use IW-Continuity Bridge to resume shared Work with the authorized context and the latest verified outcomes.

packages.name: Open governed Work in Spine Network MCP
packages.trigger: A signed-in user opens or resumes permitted Work from a supported host.

approval.requiredFor: Any consequential action proposed from the context review

packages.output: Work context brief with evidence, available capabilities and a next action
packages.verification: Confirm the returned Work ID and evidence references against the authorized workspace view.
packages.note: Resolve permitted context through the shared Spine Network MCP entry.

packages.name: Executive operating review
packages.note: Move from current KPI evidence to an owned leadership review.
packages.trigger: The executive team opens its scheduled operating review.

approval.requiredFor: Publishing changes to objectives, owners or executive commitments

packages.output: Operating review brief and owned follow-up Work
packages.verification: Match scorecard figures to their source versions and confirm accepted follow-ups have owners and dates.

packages.name: Leadership decision follow-through
packages.note: Carry leadership decisions into the Work they affect.
packages.trigger: A strategic decision is requested or an adopted commitment changes.

approval.requiredFor: Adopting a decision and committing teams to its consequences

packages.output: Versioned decision and linked commitments
packages.verification: Read back the decision version and confirm affected Work links and owner acknowledgments.

packages.name: Pipeline and forecast review
packages.note: Review the deals behind forecast changes before committing a revised number.
packages.trigger: A pipeline review starts or forecast assumptions materially change.

approval.requiredFor: Publishing forecast revisions or changing opportunity commitments

packages.output: Approved forecast snapshot and deal follow-ups
packages.verification: Compare adopted totals to the CRM snapshot and read back approved deal updates.

packages.name: Closed-won transition to Account Success
packages.note: Keep the customer commitments traceable when responsibility passes from Sales to Account Success.
packages.trigger: The source opportunity records a closed-won transition.

approval.reviewer: Sales owner and receiving Account Success owner
approval.requiredFor: Confirming the handoff scope and acceptance of transferred commitments

packages.output: Accepted handoff with an accountable next owner
packages.verification: Verify Account ID, originating Work ID and the receiving owner's acknowledgment.

packages.name: Revenue data quality review
packages.note: Trace revenue reporting problems to source record and definition changes.
packages.trigger: A reporting close, drift signal or data quality review identifies discrepancies.

approval.requiredFor: Applying source record corrections or changes to reporting definitions

packages.output: Reviewed discrepancy queue and reconciliation evidence
packages.verification: Recalculate reconciled totals from the authoritative source and confirm receipts for approved corrections.

packages.name: Routing and ownership change
packages.note: Review how a rule change will affect current accounts and opportunities.
packages.trigger: A territory, routing or data ownership change is proposed.

approval.requiredFor: Activating the exact revised rule and its ownership impact

packages.output: Versioned routing proposal and verification plan
packages.verification: Read back the activated rule version and compare approved sample assignments to expected ownership.

packages.name: At-risk account intervention
packages.note: Trace an account risk from evidence through the approved response.
packages.trigger: An account health change or an open customer commitment crosses a review threshold.

approval.requiredFor: Changing the recovery plan or sending a customer commitment

packages.output: Risk response plan with owner, next action and review date
packages.verification: Confirm the risk and approved actions on the same Account ID and read back the updated plan.

packages.name: Renewal and value review
packages.note: Review customer value and open commitments before the renewal decision.
packages.trigger: An account enters its renewal review period.

approval.reviewer: Account Success and authorized commercial owner
approval.requiredFor: Sharing a renewal proposal or commercial commitment

packages.output: Renewal readiness and value brief
packages.verification: Confirm dates, renewal terms and accepted next steps against the authorized account sources.

packages.name: Technical account escalation
packages.note: Hand off customer technical evidence while preserving account scope and the same Work record.
packages.trigger: A technical blocker or integration incident affects an authorized customer account.

approval.reviewer: Technical account owner and authorized incident lead
approval.requiredFor: Escalating customer data or sending a technical commitment outside the team

packages.output: Escalated Work with evidence, owner and customer-impact checkpoint
packages.verification: Match the engineering receipt, Account ID and Work ID. Confirm the impact and any recovery claim against current telemetry.

packages.name: Technical implementation readiness review
packages.note: Carry implementation readiness decisions into continued Account Success Work.
packages.trigger: A customer implementation reaches a technical acceptance milestone.

approval.reviewer: Authorized technical lead and customer acceptance owner
approval.requiredFor: Recording production readiness or accepting a milestone exception

packages.output: Reviewed technical milestone with acceptance and validation evidence
packages.verification: Confirm test results, approved exceptions and customer acceptance against the exact milestone version.

packages.name: Case triage and escalation
packages.note: Move a case to the right owner with enough evidence for immediate follow-up.
packages.trigger: A new priority case arrives or a service target is at risk.

approval.requiredFor: External escalation or commitments beyond the current support authority

packages.output: Case escalation with acknowledged ownership and response draft
packages.verification: Confirm the case receipt, queue assignment, active clock and accepted next action.

packages.name: Case closeout and customer follow-up
packages.note: Close support Work after verifying the observed result and next customer commitment.
packages.trigger: The assigned team records a possible resolution.

approval.requiredFor: Sending a customer follow-up or closing a case under review

packages.output: Verified case outcome and approved customer follow-up
packages.verification: Read back the source case status and verify the resolution evidence and any communication receipt.

packages.name: Campaign launch readiness
packages.note: Carry the campaign brief and audience evidence through the final launch decision.
packages.trigger: A campaign enters launch review.

approval.reviewer: Authorized campaign owner and responsible reviewer
approval.requiredFor: Publishing the approved assets, audience and launch plan

packages.output: Reviewed campaign launch plan with asset and audience versions
packages.verification: Match the provider's observed campaign, audience and published asset versions to the approved plan.

packages.name: Campaign performance review
packages.note: Translate performance evidence into reviewable campaign adjustments.
packages.trigger: A campaign reaches a reporting checkpoint or performance materially changes.

approval.requiredFor: Changing campaign spend, targeting or public assets

packages.output: Performance review with proposed experiments and evidence
packages.verification: Compare reported metrics to the approved attribution window and record any adopted change and its owner.

packages.name: Period close evidence review
packages.note: Review close evidence and disputed balances before recording period outcomes.
packages.trigger: Finance opens a reporting period close.

approval.requiredFor: Posting adjustments or accepting unresolved close exceptions

packages.output: Reconciled close review with exceptions, owners and supporting evidence
packages.verification: Compare approved figures to source balances and confirm receipts for any posted adjustments.

packages.name: Billing exception resolution
packages.note: Resolve billing exceptions with approval and source evidence.
packages.trigger: A disputed charge or reconciliation difference is raised.

approval.requiredFor: Applying a credit, adjustment or other source-system billing change

packages.output: Documented billing decision and independent readback
packages.verification: Verify the expected amount, currency and invoice status against the billing provider receipt and readback.

packages.name: Process exception response
packages.note: Route an operating exception through the owner who can resolve the blockage.
packages.trigger: Work stalls at a handoff or misses an operating target.

approval.requiredFor: Changing ownership, deadlines or exception treatment

packages.output: Owned exception response with a restart or escalation decision
packages.verification: Confirm the receiving owner, updated deadline and next checkpoint on the same Work ID.

packages.name: Governed runbook change
packages.note: Turn recurring process evidence into a reviewable runbook improvement.
packages.trigger: A recurring exception or process change warrants a runbook revision.

approval.requiredFor: Publishing the new runbook version

packages.output: Approved runbook revision and validation record
packages.verification: Read back the published version and check a representative case against the approved handoff and controls.

packages.name: Discovery and roadmap prioritization
packages.note: Carry product discovery evidence into an owned prioritization decision.
packages.trigger: A discovery review considers new product opportunities.

approval.requiredFor: Changing adopted roadmap priorities or communicating commitments

packages.output: Versioned priority decision with evidence and next discovery actions
packages.verification: Confirm the roadmap decision version, affected Work IDs and any communicated commitments.

packages.name: Feature release adoption review
packages.note: Review observed usage and customer friction after a release.
packages.trigger: A released feature reaches an adoption checkpoint.

approval.requiredFor: Recording a release outcome or committing corrective work

packages.output: Release adoption review with agreed success measures and follow-up
packages.verification: Compare reported adoption to the approved measurement window and confirm owned follow-up Work.

packages.name: Incident coordination and recovery verification
packages.note: Keep incident impact, mitigation and recovery traceable in one Work record.
packages.trigger: On-call confirms an incident affecting a supported service.

approval.reviewer: Authorized incident commander or change owner
approval.requiredFor: Applying a production mitigation or publishing an external status update

packages.output: Incident record with verified recovery evidence and follow-up Work
packages.verification: Match mitigation receipts to the incident and confirm sustained recovery from observed service telemetry.

packages.name: Release readiness and verification
packages.note: Connect release approval to independent evidence of the actual rollout.
packages.trigger: A release candidate is submitted for go-live review.

approval.requiredFor: Deploying the exact reviewed release candidate

packages.output: Release decision with acceptance evidence and observed rollout status
packages.verification: Confirm deployed version, health indicators and acceptance results against the approved release plan.

packages.name: Hiring process coordination review
packages.note: Keep recruiting logistics and policy evidence available to authorized human decision owners.
packages.trigger: An approved requisition reaches a scheduling or process checkpoint.

approval.requiredFor: External candidate communication or an approved process exception

packages.output: Recruiting process checklist with owners and outstanding actions
packages.verification: Confirm the approved schedule and recruiting system receipts using permitted references.

packages.name: Employee onboarding readiness review
packages.note: Coordinate new-joiner tasks while preserving employee record permissions.
packages.trigger: An authorized new-joiner case reaches its pre-start checkpoint.

approval.reviewer: Authorized People owner and access approver
approval.requiredFor: Granting access or approving an onboarding exception

packages.output: Onboarding checklist with verified readiness and outstanding tasks
packages.verification: Read back approved access and task statuses from the responsible source systems.

packages.name: Contract review and approval
packages.note: Give human reviewers the version and clause evidence needed to approve the exact agreement.
packages.trigger: An authorized contract draft enters review.

approval.requiredFor: Approving final terms or releasing a document for signature

packages.output: Reviewed contract version and linked obligations for follow-up
packages.verification: Compare the approved and signed document versions and confirm the accepted obligations.

packages.name: Compliance evidence and obligations review
packages.note: Keep compliance findings connected to the evidence reviewed and the responsible owner.
packages.trigger: A compliance control or confirmed obligation reaches a review checkpoint.

approval.requiredFor: Attesting control completion or signing off on a finding

packages.output: Scoped evidence packet and reviewed remediation Work
packages.verification: Confirm evidence freshness and match the reviewed decision to the correct obligation or control version.

packages.name: Connector activation verification
packages.note: Verify the Marketplace-to-Platform activation path through identity, consent, binding and readback.
packages.trigger: A tenant administrator requests activation of an approved Marketplace connector.

approval.reviewer: Authorized tenant administrator and account owner
approval.requiredFor: Binding the exact provider account and granting capability access

packages.output: Tenant-scoped activation evidence with permitted capabilities and a readback result
packages.verification: Confirm the signed-in binding, granted scope and authorized readback for the selected account.

packages.name: Verify cross-host Work resume
packages.note: Verify cross-host continuity while retaining the effective workspace and actor grants.
packages.trigger: An authorized user requests to resume Work from another approved host.

approval.requiredFor: Confirming the recipient and permitted handoff context

packages.output: Resume checkpoint with verified Work ID, decisions and next action
packages.verification: Read back the same Work on the destination through Spine Network MCP and compare the scoped IW-Continuity references with Platform.
